motivation: Exact primitive-row deduplication across every eligible seed is the correct selection metric but cannot be recomputed for 101 checkpoints times every threshold_method_K tuple. A deterministic high-recall proxy shortlist preserves direct primitive final selection without making region evidence the final objective.

training_schedule.reason: fixed before validation; avoids using an unaligned BCE or region proxy for early stopping

proxy_seed_subset_per_validation_scene.construction: include the lowest-canonical-index eligible seed for every positive instance then fill remaining slots by deterministic evenly-spaced indices over the remaining canonical-order eligible seeds

deterministic_shortlist_per_checkpoint.per_method_and_K: for each method and each K in 2_4_8 include its one proxy-best threshold
deterministic_shortlist_per_checkpoint.global_supplement: include the proxy-global top 8 nonsingleton tuples before deduplication

exact_selection.seeds: all eligible positive-instance validation region seeds
